messages:
emma (product): Quick sync: finalize UX for key rotation + revoke flows. Need copy for undo snackbar and guidance for clipboard-fallback.

Diego (design): For revoke undo: snackbar text 'Key revoked. Undo' is fine. For confirm dialog use: 'Revoking may immediately break running apps.' Keep dialog short.

sam (devex): Clipboard fallback plan: if navigator.clipboard fails, open a small modal with the secret in a selectable code block and a 'Select all' button. Include a visible copy instruction and a copy-failed telemetry event (no secret).

hao (eng): Tech constraints: mask secret in DOM after 20s and clear JS refs. Never include secret in analytics/events. For Download .env, generate a JS Blob at runtime (no href with secret).

nina (a11y): Accessibility: after creation move focus to the secret region and announce via aria-live polite: 'API key created, secret ready to copy.' Copy button aria-label: 'Copy secret to clipboard \u2014 will not be shown again.' Revoke dialog must be role=alertdialog and trap focus.

Diego (design): Empty state: make the CTA action-first 'Create your first key' with three tiny use-case chips. For brand-new orgs only, offer an ephemeral demo key. Add 'Invite Key Manager' link near CTA.

emma (product): Also add a lightweight 24h reminder banner if user didn't copy the secret: 'Remember to save your new key' (no secret displayed).

sam (devex): Bulk revoke: for >25 keys require typed confirmation of the org name. Show affected-count and 'may break apps' warning. Undo snackbar 30s. Provide downloadable affected-IDs CSV in snackbar for large operations.

hao (eng): We'll add last_used to the list API and an audit_link per key. Enforce server-side role checks for secret view. Staged rollout is out of scope for this cycle.

nina (a11y): Ensure table headers are keyboard-focusable and announce sort state. All CTAs need visible focus rings and high-contrast labels.

emma (product): Action items: diego -> update mocks with inline reveal + demo variant; nina -> ARIA snippet doc; sam -> clipboard-fallback + blob doc; hao -> API tickets for last_used & audit_link. Deploy branch \"feature/key-ux-final\" to staging.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch \"feature/key-ux-final\" to staging at 2026-03-26T11:20:00Z

emma (product): Thanks team!
